fields.name: Ebb and Flow
fields.effect_text: Swap with an enemy minion in range; if it was adjacent to you, may repeat once.

fields.name: Stranger Tide
fields.effect_text: Place yourself into a space in range without a spawn point.

fields.name: Deluge
fields.effect_text: This turn: Enemy heroes in radius cannot fast travel, or move more than 1 space with a movement action.

fields.name: Master Duelist
fields.effect_text: Ignore all minion defense modifiers. This round: You are immune to attack actions of all enemy heroes, except this attacker.

fields.name: Violent Torrent
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. Before the attack: Up to 1 enemy hero in any of the 5 spaces in a straight line directly behind the target discards a card, or is defeated. May repeat once on a different unit.

fields.name: Tidal Blast
fields.effect_text: Target a unit in range. After the attack: You may push an enemy unit adjacent to you up to 3 spaces.

fields.name: Arcane Whirlpool
fields.effect_text: Swap with an enemy minion in range.

fields.name: Magical Current
fields.effect_text: Place yourself into a space in range without a spawn point and not adjacent to an empty spawn point.

fields.name: Expert Duelist
fields.effect_text: Ignore all minion defense modifiers. This turn: You are immune to attack actions of all enemy heroes, except this attacker.

fields.name: Slippery Ground
fields.effect_text: This turn: Enemy heroes adjacent to you cannot fast travel, or move more than 1 space with a movement action.

fields.name: Rogue Wave
fields.effect_text: Target a unit in range. After the attack: You may push an enemy unit adjacent to you up to 2 spaces.

fields.name: Raging Stream
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. Before the attack: Up to 1 enemy hero in any of the 3 spaces in a straight line directly behind the target discards a card, or is defeated.

fields.name: Spell Break
fields.effect_text: This turn: Enemy heroes in radius cannot perform skill actions, except on gold cards.

fields.name: Noble Blade
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. Before the attack: You may move another unit that is adjacent to the target 1 space.

fields.name: Aspiring Duelist
fields.effect_text: Ignore all minion defense modifiers.

fields.name: Dangerous Current
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. Before the attack: Up to 1 enemy hero in any of the 2 spaces in a straight line directly behind the target discards a card, or is defeated.

fields.name: Liquid Leap
fields.effect_text: Place yourself into a space in range without a spawn point and not adjacent to an empty spawn point.

fields.name: Living Tsunami
fields.effect_text: Once per turn, before performing an Attack action, you may move 1 space.

fields.name: Team Spirit
fields.effect_text:
Swap with a friendly hero in range.
Move another one of you up to 3 spaces.

fields.name: Aaaand It's Gone!
fields.effect_text: Push a unit adjacent to you up to 3 spaces; for every space the target moved, move this one of you one space in the opposite direction.

fields.name: Wire Dancers
fields.effect_text: After you move, move another one of you up to 3 spaces.

fields.name: Spectacle
fields.effect_text:
Swap with a minion in range.
May repeat once by another one of you, targeting a different minion.

fields.name: Into Thin Air
fields.effect_text:
Target a unit adjacent to you.
After the attack: You may remove one or more of you in play, including all of you.
( If all are removed, you are not defeated. Respawn as normal. )

fields.name: Ransack
fields.effect_text:
Target a unit adjacent to you.
After the attack: For each other one of you in radius, you may retrieve a discarded card.

fields.name: Group Performance
fields.effect_text:
Swap with a friendly hero in range.
Move another one of you up to 2 spaces.

fields.name: Magic Trick
fields.effect_text: Push a unit adjacent to you up to 2 spaces; for every space the target moved, move this one of you one space in the opposite direction.

fields.name: High Wire
fields.effect_text: After you move, move another one of you up to 2 spaces.

fields.name: Theatrics
fields.effect_text: Swap with a minion in range.

fields.name: Hit and Gone
fields.effect_text:
Target a unit adjacent to you. After the attack:
You may remove one or more of you in play, except the last one of you.

fields.name: Rummage
fields.effect_text:
Target a unit adjacent to you.
After the attack: If there is another one of you in radius, you may retrieve a discarded card.
( All of you share cards in hand, deck, and discard. )

fields.name: Alleyoop
fields.effect_text:
Swap with a friendly hero in range.
Move another one of you up to 1 space.

fields.name: Tightrope
fields.effect_text: After you move, you may move another one of you 1 space.

fields.name: Phantom Strike
fields.effect_text:
Target a unit adjacent to you. After the attack:
If there is more than one of you in play, you may remove one of you.

fields.name: Crowd Control
fields.effect_text:
When used as a defense action, +2 :defense: Defense for each other one of you in radius.
When used as a skill action, remove all other you in play.

fields.name: Stunt Doubles
fields.effect_text:
Target a unit adjacent to you. After the attack:
Spawn up to 3 more of you in radius; each of you is the same hero, except when actions are performed. If defeated, remove all of you.

fields.name: Twin Strike
fields.effect_text: After you perform a basic attack action, another one of you may repeat it once, targeting a different unit.

fields.name: Avalanche
fields.effect_text:
You may move a unit in range 1 space to a space adjacent to terrain, or a :rock_token: Rock token.
May repeat once.

fields.name: Strolling Stone
fields.effect_text: Move any number of spaces in a straight line, ignoring obstacles, without moving through more than two empty spaces.

fields.name: Boulderdozer
fields.effect_text: Push a token, or an enemy unit, adjacent to you 1, 2, 3 or 4 spaces, ignoring obstacles; you may move up to 4 spaces in the direction of the push, ignoring obstacles.

fields.name: Ground Shaker
fields.effect_text:
Move a unit in radius which is adjacent to terrain, or to a :rock_token: Rock token, 1 space.
Place a Rock token in the space it occupied.
May repeat once on a different target.

fields.name: Epicenter
fields.effect_text:
An enemy hero in radius adjacent to terrain, or to a :rock_token: Rock token, discards a card, or is defeated.
May repeat once on a different target.

fields.name: Rock Solid
fields.effect_text:
You may retrieve a discarded card.
This round: If you would discard a card from your hand, you may discard this card instead; you may discard this card to perform its defense action, as if it was in your hand.

fields.name: Rockslide
fields.effect_text: You may move a unit in range 1 space to a space adjacent to terrain, or a :rock_token: Rock token.

fields.name: Rolling Stone
fields.effect_text:
Move any number of spaces in a straight line, ignoring obstacles, without moving through more than one empty space.
( The starting space and the destination space do not count. )

fields.name: Boulder Blitz
fields.effect_text: Push a token, or an enemy unit, adjacent to you 1, 2 or 3 spaces, ignoring obstacles; you may move up to 3 spaces in the direction of the push, ignoring obstacles.

fields.name: Stomping Step
fields.effect_text:
Move a unit in radius which is adjacent to terrain, or to a :rock_token: Rock token, 1 space.
Place a Rock token in the space it occupied.

fields.name: Seismic Assault
fields.effect_text: An enemy hero in radius adjacent to terrain, or to a :rock_token: Rock token, discards a card, or is defeated.

fields.name: Stone Carapace
fields.effect_text: This round: If you would discard a card from your hand, you may discard this card instead; you may discard this card to perform its defense action, as if it was in your hand.

fields.name: Treacherous Ground
fields.effect_text: You may move a unit in range 1 space to a space adjacent to terrain, or a :rock_token: Rock token.

fields.name: Boulder Rush
fields.effect_text: Push a token, or an enemy unit, adjacent to you 1 or 2 spaces, ignoring obstacles; you may move up to 2 spaces in the direction of the push, ignoring obstacles.

fields.name: Seismic Slam
fields.effect_text:
An enemy hero in radius adjacent to terrain, or to a :rock_token: Rock token, discards a card, or is defeated.
( The :attack: secondary Attack action is non-ranged. )

fields.name: Stone Grip
fields.effect_text: Place exactly 3 :rock_token: Rock tokens into empty spaces adjacent to an enemy hero in range, and as far away from you as possible.

fields.name: Fissure
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. After the attack: Place a :rock_token: Rock token in each of the first three empty spaces in the straight line from you in the direction of the attack.

fields.name: Rock and a Hard Place
fields.effect_text: Once per turn, after you place one or more :rock_token: Rock tokens into one or more spaces adjacent to one or more enemy heroes, each of those heroes discards a card, if able.

fields.name: Safe Travels
fields.effect_text:
Swap with an enemy hero in radius.
This turn: That hero is immune.
End of turn: Swap with that hero, regardless of radius and immunity. You may move 1 space.

fields.name: That Way!
fields.effect_text: A friendly hero in radius chooses a distance of 1, 2 or 3; move both of you that number of spaces in the same direction of your choice.

fields.name: See Nothing
fields.effect_text:
Swap with an enemy hero in radius.
You may move 1 space.

fields.name: Monkey Business
fields.effect_text:
Swap two friendly units in radius.
You may move 1 space.

fields.name: Trusted Sidekick
fields.effect_text:
Choose one, or both, in any order —
• Target a unit adjacent to you.
• Target a hero in range, adjacent to your friendly hero and not adjacent to you.

fields.name: Pile On
fields.effect_text:
Choose one, or both, in any order —
• Target a unit adjacent to you.
• Target a minion in range, adjacent to your friendly hero.

fields.name: There and Back Again
fields.effect_text:
Swap with an enemy hero in radius.
This turn: That hero is immune.
End of turn: Swap with that hero, regardless of radius and immunity.

fields.name: This Way!
fields.effect_text:
A friendly hero in radius chooses a distance of 1 or 2; move both of you that number of spaces in the same direction of your choice.
( Both must be moved the full distance, or neither one moves. )

fields.name: Monkey Twist
fields.effect_text: Swap two friendly units in radius.

fields.name: Hear Nothing
fields.effect_text: Swap with an enemy hero in radius.

fields.name: Even the Odds
fields.effect_text:
Choose one —
• Target a unit adjacent to you.
• Target a hero in range, adjacent to your friendly hero.

fields.name: Outnumber
fields.effect_text:
Choose one —
• Target a unit adjacent to you.
• Target a minion in range, adjacent to your friendly hero.

fields.name: Unexpected Journey
fields.effect_text:
Swap with an enemy hero in radius.
This turn: That hero is immune.
End of turn: Swap with that hero, regardless of radius and immunity.

fields.name: Monkey Trick
fields.effect_text: Swap two friendly units in radius.

fields.name: Helping Hand
fields.effect_text:
Choose one —
• Target a unit adjacent to you.
• Target a hero in range, adjacent to your friendly hero.

fields.name: Hurry Up!
fields.effect_text:
Set the printed :initiative: Initiative value of an unresolved card of a hero in range to 11, until it is resolved, or otherwise changes state.
( This may change the initiative order and tie breakers. )

fields.name: Fight and Flight
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. If the target is not defeated, After the attack: If able, move 3 spaces in a straight line.

fields.name: The Ultimate Trick
fields.effect_text: You choose the next action, and how it is performed, for a hero you target with the "Hurry Up!".
